create_likelihood_overlay: create a likelihood overlay RGB image from a probability map with optional map visualization blending
create_heatmap_rgb: create an RGB heatmap image from score values with optional masking and configurable colormap
plot_camera_pose: plot a camera pose with position and yaw orientation arrows on a matplotlib axis
plot_dense_rotations: plot dense rotation arrows from a probability tensor showing orientation predictions above a threshold
add_circle_inset: add a circular inset zoom view centered on a point of interest on a matplotlib axis
